title: Detroit's parts bill: 25% at every crossing
sub: Duty per component on one American pickup, $ - the 25% parts rate on a modelled cross-border bill of materials, three of six crossings named
src: DERIVED from USITC HTS ch 8708 (25% parts duty) and CAR (6-8 crossings) - component values are a model, not a quote

facts.note: the three named parts sum to $3,950; the hand-off's $6,240 stacked total is its own model (an $18,000 BOM across six crossings) and does not reduce to these three
